name: Hayden Adams
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: The Twitter account of Uniswap founder Hayden Adams was hacked, and the account sent multiple tweets containing links to scam websites. "Hayden's account has been hacked," the Uniswap Foundation said in a tweet. "Do not click on this link, or one that may appear in similar tweets."
